$comment: Y8 ceilings for the foundation tier, as PLAN.md decision D1 defines them: the ceiling is the incumbent's installed bytes **including its dependency tree** — what a user actually removes by switching — because four of six foundation layers have no zero-dependency incumbent to anchor against at all. Where a zero-dep incumbent exists it is named separately as the harder target. Measured by `installedBytes` in benchmarks/axes/weight.ts, which walks each tree once and counts every installed copy exactly once.
method: benchmarks/axes/weight.ts installedBytes(name), tree-inclusive, one count per realpath

paratext.$unmeasured: Not installed in this workspace, so its bytes are absent from `ceiling` — the ceiling is therefore a floor on the real one, never an overstatement.

seniority.$note: A zero-dependency incumbent exists here, so Y8's original wording applies too and beating it is reported separately.
seniority.$grew: 151,688 B on 2026-09-14, up from 53,475 — PLAN 3.2 built the cosmiconfig-compatible surface plus the `./dotenv` and `./find-up` façades, and the pack grew 182%. The Y8 ratio moved 0.034 to 0.098, so it is still an order of magnitude under what it replaces; the growth is recorded rather than smoothed because a ratio that only ever improves is a ratio nobody is watching.

bellpull.note: Measured 2026-09-16 (82,918 after `cross-spawn.ts` moved to a live property read so commander’s mock is seen), the first time this package had an implementation to weigh: 0.0067 was a seven-line stub exporting its own name. R8's ceiling is the wrong comparison and is left as-is rather than quietly swapped: it asks for bytes under `tinyexec`, which does not resolve executables at all, so the smaller number would win by not doing the job. `tinyexec` is not installed here, so no number is claimed against it. Note the fixed point: `ours` is measured from a tarball that contains a README generated from `ours`, so writing the number changes it. 82,918 became 82,917 when the ratio string lost a character; 0.116 is stable under regeneration, which is why it stops here rather than oscillating.

$remeasured: 2026-09-20, one pass with `npm pack --dry-run --json`, after Stage 2's artifact was renamed `design.md` to `spec.md` (D-057). What moved: linegauge 83,538 to 83,536 (-2); paratext 66,343 to 66,341 (-2); closeout 84,455 to 84,453 (-2); bellpull 86,113 to 86,107 (-6). Every move is -2 bytes per surviving reference: `design.md` is nine characters and `spec.md` is seven, and these packages cite their own spec from published source or from a generated README section. seniority and caique did not move — neither cites the file from anything that ships. No ceiling moved; ceilings are the incumbents' bytes and no incumbent changed.
